limitations: 102 passing assertions per lane comprise the rebound existing 53 assertions and 49 added assertions; they are not 102 native display-transition scenarios.

The fixture substitutes GetNSWindow, CurrentLayerDrawableSize, CocoaBackingScale (constant 2), SDL, NSScreen/NSWindow and GL. Production NativeCocoaDrawableScale, full QueryDisplayGeometry, new helper, coordinate rounding and viewport/scissor bodies are exact. The fixture does not execute SDL properties access, real CAMetalLayer type/content-view checks or actual NSScreen backing scale discovery.

UpdateViewPortGeometry fixture coverage is only its single-screen prefix; full production function is byte-unchanged. Display-move/fullscreen-named assertions mutate fixture fields, not a real macOS Space or event loop.

The displayQueries counter counts five SDL display-query doubles. In particular, offscreen-no-size-query does not count SDL_GetWindowSize or CurrentLayerDrawableSize and cannot alone prove no size-helper invocation; the unchanged production early return proves the FBO bypass by static inspection. Native/retina fallback can still read Cocoa backing scale/mainScreen through the existing helper.

No atomic snapshot of logical size and CAMetalLayer size is added. The old and new paths read them separately; concurrent native resize/transition timing and Cocoa thread safety are outside CPU proof.
Existing ASan/UBSan runs disable leak detection; they check only exercised fixture code, not native GPU/driver behavior, race freedom or complete app lifetime.

Native input manifests cover selected workspace source extensions reported by Ninja; their pre/post stability is supported by the reviewed build script and current hashes, not a full reproducible-build attestation of SDK/toolchain/environment or all historical source changes.

Strict deep signature verification is accepted from the completed packaging receipt and reviewed fail-fast packaging script. Reviewer did not rerun codesign. Current full inventories and engine/launcher Mach-O data were independently read back.

This is approval of the narrow applied change and frozen local cumulative artifact for the next authorized validation stage. It does not qualify earlier cumulative optimizations anew, establish FPS improvement, or accept game/GPU/Metal3/Metal4/fullscreen/multiplayer/other-Mac behavior. Version metadata remains BAR-1.0.3; no release publication is approved by this review.
